text: {"features":[{"name":"Software lifecycle scope","description":"How much relevant professional experience the letter shows across testing, maintaining, launching, and operating production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only early-career scope with limited production ownership, usually a small number of services and a bare statement of lifecycle experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some relevant production experience across the lifecycle, but the scope or ownership still appears modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid professional experience with clear responsibility for multiple production services across testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial lifecycle experience with repeated launches, maintenance work, and dependable ownership of several production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, clearly relevant production experience with sustained ownership of many services and a mature view of how software behaves over time."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates Go as a serious working language for backend or infrastructure development.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Only notes Go as a language used, with no real sense of depth or backend ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a primary language but gives little detail about what was built in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Links Go to credible production backend work in a general way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Go ownership through multiple backend systems or clear architectural responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents deep Go-led backend or control-plane expertise as a central reason for fit with the role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates meaningful Python use for services, automation, analysis, or agent behavior.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python, or mentions it only indirectly through agents without showing broader use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python familiarity but only at the level of light scripting or generic comfort."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, analysis, automation, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python use across services, automation, or internal platforms."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Positions Python as a major working language with production-grade practices or central responsibility for automation and agent behavior."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"Depth of experience building and operating AI or LLM-based functionality in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any AI or LLM work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without describing real production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes direct experience shipping or integrating AI features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI work with attention to reliability, evaluation, or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial hands-on AI experience in production plus a clear understanding of failure modes, trustworthiness, or deployment discipline."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"Evidence of designing agentic systems with clear boundaries between agents and the infrastructure that governs them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic tooling or agent design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous workflows only in passing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic systems at a high level, usually with Python agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains end-to-end agent architecture, including agent autonomy plus system constraints or auditability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents sophisticated agent design with explicit contracts, permissions, guardrails, or supervisory infrastructure that shows strong architectural judgment."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Depth of experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, deduplication, routing, or related security response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not describe any experience automating vulnerability handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References security automation in broad terms without showing ownership of triage workflow changes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant built or helped build vulnerability intake or triage automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains concrete triage mechanics such as classification, deduplication, routing, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep ownership of vulnerability handling automation, explaining concrete mechanisms such as triage, deduplication, routing, or variant analysis plus clear impact on expert workload or response capacity."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates structured experience assessing the security of designs or running systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions reviews or security work only broadly, without method or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes conducting security assessments, code reviews, or threat models in a credible but general way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows structured assessment practice with specific methods plus remediation or follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents mature assessment experience across new and existing services, emphasizing attacker-aware reasoning, documented findings, and validated fixes."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical data-structures and algorithms skill applied to real engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not substantiate algorithmic ability beyond a generic claim, or omits it entirely."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions data structures or algorithms but without a concrete application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of using algorithmic thinking to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical fluency through a clearly described redesign or performance improvement grounded in structure choice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates standout algorithmic depth by tying sophisticated problem reframing to meaningful gains in tractability, correctness, or throughput."}]},{"name":"Security enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security as helping developers build safely by default rather than adding after-the-fact friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security mainly as a domain of interest, with little emphasis on helping developers work securely."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a brief or generic reference to secure defaults, process improvement, or reduced toil."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear preference for embedding security into the development lifecycle rather than applying it afterward."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Emphasizes reducing developer friction, scaling expert judgment, or making the secure path the easy path."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently frames security as an enabling systems problem centered on developer adoption, everyday workflow, and leverage rather than policing."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How strongly the letter values foundational work whose impact compounds across many teams, products, or users.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses general excitement about the company or role without explaining the appeal of foundational impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or impact only in broad, generic terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Identifies company-wide reach or foundational systems as part of the appeal."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values central infrastructure or shared tooling because improvements compound across many teams or users."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes multiplier effects, capacity creation, or fleet-wide protection a central theme linking past work to future goals."}]},{"name":"Security collaboration readiness","description":"How clearly the letter shows readiness to work closely with information security specialists in a joint engineering-security context.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no specific signal about partnering with security specialists or similar stakeholders."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses general teamwork language without showing particular fit for collaboration with security experts."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly says the applicant wants to work alongside security engineers or related specialists."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows experience collaborating with security practitioners or translating security needs into engineering tools."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong joint engineering-security fit by describing security work as collaborative craft and showing how the applicant complements specialists."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter signals a preference for building durable, maintainable, production-ready systems that others can safely depend on.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides little signal about reliability or maintainability beyond generic production claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a broad quality-focused statement without showing a durable-systems orientation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"References maintenance, testing, or dependable operation as meaningful parts of the work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values maintainability, safe defaults, or quiet reliability in production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a distinct maintainer philosophy backed by examples of inheritable systems, production discipline, or rigorous engineering practices."}]},{"name":"Role alignment","description":"How directly the letter maps the applicant's background to the specific mandate, technologies, and responsibilities of this job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a broad backend or security letter that could fit many roles and only loosely addresses this posting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References the role title or one major requirement but does not map background to the posted work in much detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects several experiences to the role in a reasonably direct way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly maps background to major responsibilities and preferred qualifications in the posting."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows precise, integrated alignment to the team's mandate, technologies, and operating context, making the fit feel highly specific rather than generic."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concretely the letter supports its claims with observable actions, examples, mechanisms, and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on unsupported claims, with little concrete detail about actions or outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Offers some specific activities but leaves mechanisms or results largely implicit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one clear example of what was built, assessed, or improved."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses multiple concrete examples and usually indicates why they mattered."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds claims in specific technical actions, scope, and outcomes such as reduced manual work, improved reliability, or better performance."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter turns the applicant's background and motivations into a clear, persuasive professional story.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads mainly as a list of qualifications with little through-line or personal logic."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic reason for applying but only a loose connection between past experience and this next step."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a coherent story that links prior work to current interest."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a persuasive arc that makes the role feel like a natural progression."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a memorable, integrated narrative in which the opening, evidence, and motivation all reinforce the same professional trajectory."}]},{"name":"Security growth initiative","description":"Evidence of building security expertise beyond normal job duties through certifications, competitions, or other self-directed practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no clear evidence of building security skills beyond normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows light self-directed growth such as casual practice or a general interest in learning more."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows one meaningful external signal such as regular capture-the-flag participation or a foundational certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained security development through recurring practice plus a recognized credential or strong performance in one area."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven security growth, such as advanced certification, top competitive performance, or sustained offensive practice combined with other external signals."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"Depth of contribution to public software through patches, maintenance, releases, or community responsibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or minor contributions without sustained responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring upstream contribution or ownership of a small public project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows active maintainership or substantial contribution responsibility, including reviews or releases."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong stewardship of a public project with ongoing review, release management, and evidence of real external users or community reliance."}]},{"name":"Independent systems building","description":"Evidence of self-directed technical projects outside work that demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and end-to-end engineering ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no self-directed technical project outside assigned duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal utility or light side project with limited technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a sustained side project that demonstrates follow-through and end-to-end ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a substantive self-driven project chosen to tackle meaningful engineering constraints or unfamiliar layers of the stack."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows unusually ambitious independent systems work, such as distributed infrastructure or fault-tolerant systems built end to end."}]},{"name":"Writing structure","description":"How clearly and effectively the letter is organized as an argument for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The argument is noticeably choppy or weakly sequenced, making the case harder to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"A basic structure is present, but paragraph flow or emphasis feels uneven."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is clearly organized, with a logical progression through background, fit, and motivation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The structure is purposeful and easy to follow, with transitions that strengthen the argument."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The organization is highly polished, guiding the reader smoothly through a compelling case with excellent pacing and emphasis."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the sentence-level writing is in spelling, grammar, and surface correctness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, typo, or grammar errors repeatedly distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Noticeable mechanical errors appear throughout and reduce professionalism, though meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few errors or awkward phrases appear but do not seriously distract."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Only minor or isolated issues appear, and the prose feels generally polished."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The prose is essentially error-free and professionally polished at the sentence level."}]}]}
